tasks.title: Markdown in descriptions: render it, or leave it as typed?
tasks.description:
🟢 #48 · Markdown in a description: render it, or show it as typed?

Coral's rec: Render it. On the card face, strip the marks and show plain text. In the open card, show headings, bold and lists, and make links tappable. When you tap to edit, you see the text as typed, marks and all. No images and no HTML. Free tier.
